name: Requirements and non-habitable use classification
requiredEvidence: Owner-approved scope actual use and contents exclusions occupancy policy foreseeable misuse and requirement baseline
acceptanceAuthority: Owner with AHJ and responsible design leads as required

name: Site legal property and permit pathway
requiredEvidence: Controlled site identity property and investigation authorization easements AHJ determination adopted code register and required permit plan
acceptanceAuthority: Owner property authority and applicable AHJs

name: Official utility locates and conflict clearance
requiredEvidence: Current official locate records utility-owner responses positive identification where required isolation support and conflict disposition
acceptanceAuthority: Competent excavation person utility owners and responsible site authority

name: Geotechnical groundwater and soil basis
requiredEvidence: Signed geotechnical report field and laboratory records groundwater assessment competent soil classification settlement bearing uplift and constructability recommendations
acceptanceAuthority: Qualified geotechnical engineer and competent excavation person within respective scopes

name: Structural reinforcement concrete mix and durability release
requiredEvidence: Site-specific calculations released drawings reinforcement and embeds concrete mix and durability specifications joints loads uplift and independent design review
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible structural engineer with geotechnical and materials review as required

name: Excavation protective system access and rescue readiness
requiredEvidence: Engineered protective system excavation permits competent-person plan access water and surcharge controls atmospheric assessment testing ventilation and rescue arrangements where applicable
acceptanceAuthority: Competent excavation person responsible engineers employer and site authority

name: Environmental archaeological contamination and spoil acceptance
requiredEvidence: Required environmental heritage assessments contamination and gas findings erosion discharge waste and spoil plans permits and stop-work contacts
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible environmental heritage specialists and applicable authorities

name: Lifting plan equipment rigging and inspection
requiredEvidence: Task-specific approved lift plans ground and overhead assessment rated equipment and rigging records competent personnel and exclusion-zone arrangements
acceptanceAuthority: Qualified lift director or equivalent responsible lifting authority

name: Formwork reinforcement embeds and preplacement inspection
requiredEvidence: Released configuration inspections for formwork falsework reinforcement cover joints embeds sleeves cleanliness access testing and preplacement approvals
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible structural engineer formwork specialist and required inspectors

name: Concrete placement tests cure and structural acceptance
requiredEvidence: Batch and placement traceability calibrated test results curing records nonconformances structural review and authorization for later loading or concealment
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible structural/materials engineers and required testing/inspection authorities

name: Waterproofing and drainage acceptance
requiredEvidence: Substrate membrane joint and penetration inspection protection drainage and cleanout records flood/backflow review specified tests and as-built details
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible civil/waterproofing designers and required inspectors

name: Backfill compaction and restoration acceptance
requiredEvidence: Released backfill sequence material and compaction records waterproofing protection verification structure review survey and surface drainage restoration evidence
acceptanceAuthority: Responsible geotechnical/structural/civil reviewers and required inspectors

name: Electrical fire ventilation controls and life-safety acceptance
requiredEvidence: Coordinated commissioning inspection calibrated test results grounding isolation ventilation fire detection alarm lighting network loss-of-power behavior emergency review and resolved deviations
acceptanceAuthority: Qualified electrical mechanical/fire and life-safety reviewers plus AHJs as required

name: Final authority acceptance and maintenance handover
requiredEvidence: Final inspections permits closed deviations as-builts component records residual risks maintenance and emergency plans owner training and complete controlled evidence index
acceptanceAuthority: Applicable AHJs responsible engineers owner and maintenance receiver

name: Final occupancy and use classification
requiredEvidence: Written non-habitable equipment/storage classification entry restrictions permitted contents prohibited uses signage and any legally required use authorization
acceptanceAuthority: AHJ owner and responsible fire/life-safety authority
